text:
mia: starting midnight ramp for feature flag `llmroute_v3_enable`. window 00:00-02:00 UTC tonight. plan: canary 1% -> 10% after 15m -> 50% after 45m -> 100% after 90m. holdpoints at every step until telemetry green. canary scoped to eu-west-1 only. model pinned to model-route v3.0.2. @deploybot please execute, @sre-oncall FYI.

deploybot: ack — scheduled 00:00-02:00 UTC. queued steps: canary 1% @ 00:00, watch 15m, then ramp per plan. will post step completions.

ben: rollback triggers? propose: cpu > 70% sustained for 5m OR p95 latency > 450ms OR error rate > 0.5% (5m).

olivia: +1. also add quality regression: prompt-eval drift > 2% vs baseline for recent eval set => auto rollback. include quick-check evals pre/post canary.

sam: are we pinning client routing on rollback? if unstable we want immediate pin to v2.0.9. runbook link: https://go/runbooks/llmroute-ff (see section "fast pinback").

deploybot: noted. rollback action set: pin flag cohort=0 and route to model-route v2.0.9. rollback command (ops):
```
/deploybot rollback llmroute_v3_enable --pin-version v2.0.9
```

mia: perfect. observability: enable trace capture + token-queue-length metric. set pager thresholds and mute noisy alerts. @sre-oncall can you standby for manual roll if threshold hits?

sre-oncall: standing by. i'll watch p95, error rate, cpu, and model-token-queue-length. i'll post immediate comment and execute rollback if any threshold is breached.

deploybot: canary 1% executed at 00:00 UTC — will post metrics snapshot in ~10m.

ben: if canary stable by 00:15, schedule 10% at 00:20 and 50% at 00:45. keep quiet window rules (no other deploys to routing subsystems). :thumbsup:

mia: thanks team — we'll async monitor. i'll open a short release note for customers with the change window and fallback note.

deploybot: update: metrics posted (00:10) — prelim looks within thresholds, will wait full 15m before next step.
